payload.description: Improve scanner recall/precision on each layer against the pinned baseline performance. Gold is frozen; only scanner code changes. One task per layer gap in impact order: data-flows (0%), components (0.6%), data-items (27%), mentions (42%). Each slice: plan -> implement scanner code -> run scorecard -> diff vs baseline (recall up, precision not cratered) -> acceptance -> merge to develop -> update baseline record. Do not change gold. Do not merge to main.
payload.title: Improve scanner evaluation metrics against pinned baseline
